newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's Treasury rejects 1.8 bln dirhams offers.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's Treasury rejects 1.8 bln dirhams offers.

text.p: Morocco's Treasury rejected offers totalling 1.863 billion dirhams at its weekly treasury bill auction, Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) said on Wednesday.

Moroccan banks offered a total 1.863 billion dirhams at interest rates of between 7.50 percent and 10 percent on a period varying from 13 weeks to 15 years "but the Treasury turned down the offers," a Moroccan official said.
This is the third week running that the Treasury has rejected the offers of commercial banks, insurance and mutual fund groups, the official added.
According to a Casablanca-based market analyst "the Treasury move aims at pushing local banks to lower their interest rates which are considered as too high."
Treasury officials were not immediately available for comment.
